caption: Figure E6-1, the six FET schematic symbols two exam questions ask you to identify. Every symbol is a circle around a vertical channel bar: the drain lead leaves the top of the bar to the right (D), the source lead leaves the bottom (S), and gate leads enter from the left. Three independent discriminators resolve every option mechanically. (1) JFET vs MOSFET: on the JFETs (1, 6) the arrow sits ON the gate lead, which runs continuously to the channel bar; on the MOSFETs (2-5) the gate is an insulated plate parallel to the bar and the arrow is internal, on the substrate-source connection with a connection dot to the S lead. (2) arrow-in = N-channel, arrow-out = P-channel. (3) dual-gate parts carry two gate leads labeled G2 over G1 (4, 5). So: 1 = P-channel JFET (gate arrow points away from the channel), 2 = N-channel single-gate MOSFET (internal arrow in), 3 = P-channel single-gate MOSFET (arrow out), 4 = N-channel dual-gate MOSFET, 5 = P-channel dual-gate MOSFET, 6 = N-channel JFET (gate arrow into the channel). The keyed answers: E6A10 (N-channel dual-gate MOSFET) is symbol 4; E6A11 (P-channel junction FET) is symbol 1. Redrawn from the NCVEC pool figure.

spoken: Six circled transistor symbols in two rows of three, numbered 1 to 6 beneath. In every symbol a vertical channel bar sits inside the circle with the drain lead leaving the top right, labeled D, and the source lead leaving the bottom right, labeled S. Symbol 1: a single gate lead from the left, labeled G, carries a filled arrowhead pointing left, away from the channel - the P-channel JFET. Symbol 2: the gate is an insulated plate parallel to the bar, and a small internal arrow near the bar points in toward the channel, with a connection dot on the source lead - N-channel single-gate MOSFET. Symbol 3 is the same construction with the internal arrow pointing out - P-channel. Symbol 4 has two insulated gate leads labeled G2 over G1 and the arrow points in - the N-channel dual-gate MOSFET. Symbol 5 is the dual-gate construction with the arrow out. Symbol 6 is a JFET whose gate arrow points right, into the channel - N-channel. The exam keys: the N-channel dual-gate MOSFET is number 4, and the P-channel junction FET is number 1.
